title: plugin-security: confirmAudienceBindingSuggestion's bindingCreated cannot tell "already granted" from "not added"
body:
repo:cloud#5 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjPP1zuWBNq3nBXVei9

Found by the cloud os-dev agent on objectstack-ai/cloud#4523 (PR objectstack-ai/cloud#4530). It is an out-of-scope finding of class b, with a named producer. The reading was taken at cloud's framework pin 181ad7d4; the same code is on objectstack main 03dc62673e2.

## What happens

- `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/suggested-audience-bindings.ts`: `confirmAudienceBindingSuggestion` returns `{ suggestion, bindingCreated }`, where `bindingCreated = !before.has(set) && after.has(set)` (around line 1136).
- `false` therefore covers two different results:
  - (A) the `everyone` definition already named the set, so members already hold it;
  - (B) the re-derive did not add it, so members do not hold it.
- The doc comment (around line 1083) names only the first case.
- Both cloud consumers must now say "not confirmed" in case A, when access actually exists:
  - AI Studio publish (`packages/service-ai-studio/src/tools/member-access.ts`, `provisionMemberAccess`, PR cloud#4530);
  - the install path (`packages/service-cloud/.../environment-member-access.ts`, `installMemberAccessOf`, PR cloud#4522).

## Change

Make the answer say what a consumer needs. Either return a three-way result, for example `binding: 'created' | 'already' | 'withheld'`, or return `bound: after.has(set)` beside `bindingCreated`. Then document both cases. Pin each case with a test. cloud then reads the new field and reports `granted` for case A. The cloud half is a follow-up in the `repo:cloud` lane once a release carries this.

Seam: spec: plugin-security `confirmAudienceBindingSuggestion` return shape → runtime: cloud `provisionMemberAccess` and `installMemberAccessOf`.
